newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan capital on alert against cholera.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan capital on alert against cholera.

text.p: Venezuelan health authorities placed the capital on official alert on Tuesday to prevent a cholera outbreak that has killed six people from spreading.
The decision to declare the city of 5 million in an "epidemic emergency" state was taken after a meeting of health officials and local authorities.
"The emergency allows the possibility of seizing any food sold in the streets which could act as an agent to transmit cholera," said Deputy Health Minister Roberto Rondon.
The cholera outbreak, which started near the Colombian border, has put about 200 people in the hospital. So far only 14 cases have been reported in Caracas.
